== Related skills ==
{{see|Doublecast skill}}
* {{skill icon|Frozen Burst}}

== Notes ==
* As with any [[doublecast skill]], [[NPC]]s will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's [[area of effect]] range of an ally.
* Foes suffer two damage [[packet]]s if the caster is targeted; the skill also recharges 50% faster (in effect, the second packet hits a hexed target, triggering the effect).
* As this is a ''Hex Spell'' that can ''target an ally'', [[Holy Veil]] will double this skill's casting time when it is used on a target enchanted with it, despite the fact that this ally will not be hexed.

== Trivia ==
* This is the only targeted hex spell in the game that accepts an ally as a target.
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Mirror of Ice/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
